biotools.summary: BCAR is a fast and general aligner designed specifically to map DNA barcodes to correct sequencing errors. It provides high-accuracy barcode-sequence maps by considering quality scores during both alignment and consensus generation.
biotools.name: BCAR: Barcode-Sequence Mapper for Error Correction
